rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: A folder-trust or external-import dialog renders before any composer, and a background-work dialog can render on exit; no key may answer either, so a card is raised and the endpoint is closed instead. A plain Enter submits. Claude ghosts a rotating suggestion into an empty composer, so the ghost is stripped before the composer verdict or a suggestion would read as typed text. One Escape cancels the turn and leaves the composer empty, so no clear key and no arm signal are needed. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane carries `esc to interrupt` with a rotating spinner word and an elapsed cell; idle it carries no elapsed cell. Busy is read from the lifecycle hooks, never from that footer.
